summary: Nayax Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the postponement of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders from April 29, 2026 to May 19, 2026 to allow additional time for shareholder engagement and potential supplemental proxy materials. The record date remains March 24, 2026. The filing is a routine procedural update to a previously noticed meeting, not a special situation event. It provides revised voting deadlines and instructions but does not involve any corporate transaction, activist campaign, or strategic change. No other special-situation elements are present.
